name: separator
description: A thin line between groups of content, such as sections of a page, settings groups or toolbar items; screen readers hear it as a separator. Use vertical inside a row. Prefer spacing alone where it already reads as two groups.

props.name: orientation
props.description: horizontal spans the width of its container; vertical fills the height of the row it sits in.

props.name: ref
props.description: The rendered element: an <hr>, or a <div> when vertical.
